open_points.subject: Operation-element NodeExecution status on owner refusal
open_points.text: "The record that concludes an operation element — a send, a pre-send failure, a refusal by the owner — is built and written by `effects` ... its status being the outcome name of A09 rule 5 or rule 6."
open_points.question: When the owner refuses an effect, which NodeExecution status must `effects` write: `refused_by_owner` (A10/A11) or an A09 outcome name?
options: Always `refused_by_owner` for owner refusal, with A09 statuses only for send/pre-send paths
Map owner refusal into an A09-style status and never use `refused_by_owner` for operation elements
open_points.default_guess: Use `refused_by_owner` for owner refusal and treat the A09 phrase as applying only to send and pre-send outcomes.

open_points.subject: Disclosure class assignment for flow constants
open_points.text: "Classes of produced values... applied by the module that writes the value: `runs` for function outputs in a run and for flow inputs, `effects` for operation outputs ..., `functions` for trial outputs ..."
open_points.question: Which module is responsible for assigning and validating the disclosure class of FlowConstant values when they are stored (declared class from composition)?
options: `flows` assigns/stores the constant class when composing the flow version
`canonical_values` assigns constant classes as part of value construction
`runs` assigns constant classes when delivering constants at run start
open_points.default_guess: `flows` owns it at composition time, because constants are part of FlowVersion authoring and are written before runs.
